summary: Iteration 3 (labelled iter-4 per main-agent context) backend testing for 5 new endpoints/behaviours: GET /api/platform-config, GET /api/plans (INR pricing), GET /api/plan/status (auth-gated, admin bypass, expired/expiring flags), GET /api/public/translate-menu/{slug}?lang=xx (Claude Sonnet 4.6, cached in db.menu_translations), and default INR currency on restaurant register. Added 14 new pytest cases (TestPlatformConfig, TestPlansPricing, TestDefaultCurrencyOnRegister, TestPlanStatus, TestTranslateMenu) — ALL 14 PASS. Full regression run: 80/81 pass. The single failure is TestAIMenuFromPhoto.test_menu_from_photo_success_shape which is pre-existing (unrelated to iter-4) — the 1x1 PNG fixture is rejected by Claude Vision with 'Could not process image'.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: Claude Sonnet 4.6 rejects 1x1 PNG test fixture with 'Could not process image' -> 500. Test fixture should use a real menu photo, OR endpoint should catch this specific vision error and return 400 (bad image) instead of 500.

Endpoint is unauthenticated (public) and makes a paid Claude call on every cache miss. No rate limiting -> potential abuse: any attacker can force translations to arbitrary lang codes for any public slug. Consider rate-limiting per-IP or restricting to owner-authenticated calls the first time.
lang parameter is unvalidated free-text — any string is passed to LLM (session_id includes it). Should whitelist against lang_map keys and return 400 for unknown codes.

Cache is not invalidated when owner edits menu (items/categories/tagline/about_us). Stale translations will be served indefinitely. Owner PATCH endpoints should delete db.menu_translations docs for that restaurant_id.

days_remaining uses integer floor of seconds/86400 — an owner whose plan expires in 6 hours will read days_remaining=0 AND expiring_soon=true. If today is exactly expiry day (a few hours before midnight), days_remaining=0 is correct but the semantics conflate 'expiring today' with 'already used up'. Consider ceil() so a plan with 6h left shows days_remaining=1.

action_items: Optional: whitelist lang param on /api/public/translate-menu and rate-limit to prevent LLM abuse on the unauthenticated endpoint.
Optional: invalidate db.menu_translations cache on any owner mutation (PATCH restaurant, categories, items).
Optional: replace 1x1 PNG in TestAIMenuFromPhoto with a real menu photo asset, or make endpoint return 400 for Claude 'Could not process image' errors.
Optional: use math.ceil for days_remaining so partial days show as 1 not 0.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1365 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Split into routers/ (auth, restaurant, menu, orders, coupons, reviews, admin, plans, ai) for maintainability.

/api/public/translate-menu is unauthenticated and triggers a paid LLM call on cache miss — attacker can flood arbitrary lang codes to burn credits and pollute db.menu_translations. Add rate-limiting + lang whitelist.
Translation cache has no invalidation hook — stale translations persist across menu edits.
/api/plans is hardcoded Python list; consider moving to a db collection or config file so plan prices can be edited without a deploy.

DEFAULT_CURRENCY env variable value uses non-ASCII '₹' — works because .env is UTF-8 and python-dotenv preserves it, but any deploy tool that mishandles unicode env vars could silently ship '$' instead. Consider using ISO code 'INR' internally and mapping to symbol at render time.

rca of the issue: TestAIMenuFromPhoto.test_menu_from_photo_success_shape RCA: The test posts a hard-coded 1x1 pixel PNG. Claude Sonnet 4.6 (via LiteLLM/Anthropic API) rejects images that are too small to contain meaningful content with error 'Could not process image', which server.py surfaces as HTTP 500. Fix option A (test-only): use a real menu photo bytes fixture. Fix option B (server): wrap the Claude vision call in try/except targeting BadRequestError from vision and return HTTPException(400, 'Image could not be processed by AI'). Reproduction: POST multipart/form-data 1x1 PNG (89504E47...42 60 82 hex) to /api/ai/menu-from-photo with owner auth -> 500.
